=== account_edi_proxy_client/data/neutralize.sql 987d7a261e2be448701fbd9e5e84b3b4c95999006ee8a6387b46d204606c243b
     1	-- disable edi connections in general, and the Italian one (l10n_it_edi_sdicoop) in particular
     2	-- for malaysian edi, this script can cause issue as you could have both a demo and prod user, in which case it breaks the unique constrain. Another neutralize in the malaysian module disable the clients instead.
     3	-- Greek EDI connections are archived by l10n_gr_edi_e_invoo because changing
     4	-- a production connection to test may conflict with an existing test connection.
     5	UPDATE account_edi_proxy_client_user
     6	SET edi_mode = CASE
     7	                    WHEN proxy_type IN ('l10n_it_edi', 'peppol', 'nemhandel', 'pdp') THEN 'demo'
     8	                    ELSE 'test'
     9	               END
    10	WHERE proxy_type NOT IN ('l10n_my_edi', 'l10n_gr_edi');

=== base/data/neutralize.sql 9dcfa35dfaa43500c30ff7415b25eb68a082d3dff20cddb565af90ca05da0606
     1	-- deactivate mail servers and drop their credentials: a neutralized database
     2	-- is meant to be copied around, and an archived server still ships a working
     3	-- password in every dump
     4	UPDATE ir_mail_server
     5	   SET active = false,
     6	       smtp_user = NULL,
     7	       smtp_pass = NULL;
     8	
     9	-- insert dummy mail server to prevent using fallback servers specified using command line
    10	INSERT INTO ir_mail_server(name, smtp_port, smtp_host, smtp_encryption, active, smtp_authentication)
    11	VALUES ('neutralization - disable emails', 1025, 'invalid', 'none', true, 'login');
    12	
    13	-- deactivate crons
    14	UPDATE ir_cron
    15	   SET active = false
    16	 WHERE id NOT IN (
    17	       SELECT res_id
    18	         FROM ir_model_data
    19	        WHERE model = 'ir.cron'
    20	          AND name = 'autovacuum_job'
    21	          AND module = 'base'
    22	);
    23	
    24	-- neutralization flag for the database
    25	INSERT INTO ir_config_parameter (key, value)
    26	VALUES ('database.is_neutralized', true)
    27	    ON CONFLICT (key) DO
    28	       UPDATE SET value = true;
    29	
    30	-- deactivate webhooks
    31	UPDATE ir_act_server
    32	   SET webhook_url = 'neutralization - disable webhook'
    33	 WHERE state = 'webhook';
    34	
    35	-- prevent access to database.secret protected data
    36	UPDATE ir_config_parameter
    37	   SET value = 'dummysecret'
    38	 WHERE key = 'database.secret';
